explanation: Homologous structures have the same basic anatomical plan and evolutionary origin but may be adapted to perform different functions in different species (divergent evolution). Example: the forelimbs of a human, whale, bat, and horse all have the same basic bone pattern (humerus, radius, ulna, carpals, metacarpals, phalanges) but are modified for gripping, swimming, flying, and running. This common underlying structure suggests descent from a common ancestor.
